(327)༄༅/ /dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi man ngag zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs bka' brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa brgyud 'dzin ma

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (327)༄༅// dpal mchog dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi man ngag zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs bka' brgyud bla mar gsol ba 'debs pa brgyud 'dzin mchog rgyas zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ mchog rgyas dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang*// yan lag bdun ldan bcom ldan dus 'khor lo// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes bdag blo zungs// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar mtshungs byin rlobs// e waṃ rdo rje 'chang dbang shākya thub// rgyal ba gnyis pa gsang bdag zla ba bzang*// gsol ba 'debs so= /brgyud pa 'dzin no= /sa bcu'i sems dpa' che dang khro bo'i gtso'i// rnam 'phrul chos rgyal rigs ldan sum cu lngar// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /grub pa yongs gtso dus zhabs 'jam rdo rje// mkhas grub dus 'khor bha dra pa yab sras// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /mkhas shing mchog gzigs paṇa chen zla ba mgon// 'jig rten mig gyur 'bro lo shes rab grags// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /rdzogs sbyor lam gyis grub brnyes dkon mchog srung*// mkha' 'gros mchod gyur dpa' bo gnam la brtsegs// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /'dul 'dzin ye shes che brnyes dad pa'i rgyal// 'jam dpal gzhon nu'i rnam 'phrul chos dbang phyug /gsol ba=/ brgyud pa= /lhag lhas rjes bzung mkhas pa nam mkha' 'od// mkha' spyod yongs gtso 'ja' lus jo 'bum ma// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /sa bcu'i dbang phyug nam mkha' rgyal mtshan pa// 'jam dpal dpa' bos rjes bzung shes rab 'od// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /sangs rgyas rab gsal ngo bo chos 'od zer// rigs ldan rnam 'phrul kun spangs zhang brtson 'grus// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /byang sems chen po rgyal ba ye shes pa// mkhas btsun bzang po'i mthar thug yon tan mtsho// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /pad (328)dkar 'chang dngos kun mkhyen dol po pa// de bstan 'dzin mkhas phyogs las rnam rgyal zhabs// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /smra ba'i seng ge nya dbon kun dga' dpal// 'khrul zhig rnal 'byor grub chen kun blo gros// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /lung rtogs bstan pa yongs rdzogs dkon mchog bzang*// rig 'dzin gsal sgron nam mkha' chos skyong mtshan// gsol ba=

/brgyud pa= gnas lnga rig pa nam mkha' dpal bzang po// 'phags pa'i rnam 'phrul yongs grags rin chen bzang*// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /'jam mgon grub pa spyod 'chang grol mchog zhabs// 'dul 'dzin mkhas grub lung rig rgya mtsho'i sde// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /'jigs med shing rta kun snying rdo rje 'chang*// rgyal tshab gnas brtan rin chen rgya mtsho che// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /zab lam bstan pa'i srog 'dzin blo gros rgyal// rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ngag dbang phrin las dpal// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /sbas pa'i sangs rgyas chos rje kun bzang dbang*// rgyal sras rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i sde// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= / kha skong ni/ byams mgon kun mkhyen dharmā ka ra'i zhabs// bshad sgrub phrin las thugs kyi rdo rje can// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= / shtso ka 'di padma nyin byed dbang pos mdzad/ de'i zhal skong ni/ mi 'gyur mchog bde grub pa padma'i mtshan// 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos blo gros mtha' yas zhabs// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= / yang na ngag dbang phrin las kyi rjes su/ snying po'i don gzigs ngag dbang rnam par rgyal// rjes dran mngon gyur kun dga' chos 'phel la// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /bde chen grub pa ngag dbang dri med dpal// 'od gsal mkha' khyab ngag dbang chos 'phel rje// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /(329)shes dang shes bya dbyer med ye shes sku// dang po'i sangs rgyas blo gros mtha' yas la// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= / zhes mañdzu gho ṣas so// gdul bya thar lam mchog gyur phyag rgya che// ston mdzad mtshungs med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /rgyud sde'i mthar thug yi dam yongs kyi gtso// dus kyi 'khor lo bcom ldan rdo rje sems// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /rgyud kyi bdag mo rnal 'byor ma rigs brgya// bar chad sel mdzad srung ma drug cu la// gsol ba= /brgyud pa= /de ltar zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi// brgyud pa yid bzhin nor bur gsol btab mthus// gang gi thugs rjes bdag blo dad pa dang*// nges 'byung lhag bsam rnam dag sdom gsum brtan// byin rlabs zhugs mthus gzhan stong lta ba'i gnad// ci bzhin blor chud rdo rje'i rnal 'byor lam// bsgom pas tshe gcig nyid la dbang bzhi'i don// ma nor rdor sems 'bras bu thob byin rlobs//

ces rgyud rgyal dus kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor sbyor ba yan lag drug gi byin rlabs brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'ang rgyal khams pa tshe dbang nor bus lho phyogs kyi shambha la jo nang dpal gyi ri khrod du shing stag nag zla'i chos nyer gsum la chos 'chad pa'i thun skabs gcig tu brjod pa'o// dge'o//
